bill.title: Recognizing Charleston as the appropriate host city for the 2027 annual meeting of the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe Parliamentary Assembly.
bill.latestActionText: Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

classification.plainSummary: This resolution recognizes Charleston, South Carolina, as the appropriate host city for the 2027 annual meeting of the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe Parliamentary Assembly. It is a ceremonial measure expressing the House's support for Charleston to host this international parliamentary gathering. The resolution does not create legal obligations or change policy.

industries.rationale: Hosting a large international parliamentary assembly would generate demand for hotel rooms, event venues, and tourism services in Charleston.

disclaimer: This tool places two public records next to each other: who donated to a member of Congress, and what that member legislated on. Any overlap you see is a correlation, not causation. It is not evidence of a quid pro quo, of influence, or of wrongdoing. Legislators routinely receive support from industries in their district for the same reason they legislate on them: those industries are there.
